content: Vivaan Gupta inquires about adding a primary and secondary beneficiary to his recently activated life insurance policy (LC-2026-0456) and asks for the next premium due date. Vikram Singh provides the Beneficiary Nomination Form for completion, confirms the next premium of $1,200 is due on 15/11/2026, and reminds him of the auto-pay option.

action_items: Fill out and return the signed Beneficiary Nomination Form
Make the next premium payment of $1,200 by 15/11/2026
